findings.finding: The Ethena parties' Waiver Letter permanently terminating the lock-up/vesting on StablecoinX's ENA tokens becomes effective on 2026-10-05, the window's session, permitting ENA 'Funding Sales' for working capital after five business days' notice and subject to a Foundation ROFR and consent.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The waiver's effective date is 2026-10-05, inside the window; it lands as a status change on that day, though no sale can occur before the five-business-day notice runs out (2026-10-09 at the earliest) and the terms were public on 2026-09-17.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 8-K was filed 2026-09-17 12:00 UTC; the baseline shows the warrant up 17.5% over the last 5 sessions and +180% over 20 days since then, so the market did not sell the disclosure.
findings.why_not_priced: The terms are priced since 2026-09-17; what is not in the close is whether the company acts on the new freedom (a notice of ENA sales, which would pressure the token the equity and warrant are levered to). Nothing indicates a notice on 2026-10-05, so this is near zero.

outside_window.finding: Resale registration (S-1 effective 2026-09-14, 424B3 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-17) keeps PIPE/sponsor shares freely resalable; ongoing, undated supply on the common the warrant is levered to
First possible ENA Funding Sale under the waiver, after five business days' notice from 2026-10-05
